preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 200000 for N in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes N is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= M <= 120000 for M in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of main roads M is between 0 and 120,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line and len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() and not line.startswith('0 '))
preconditions.description: For each main road, the nodes x and y are valid (1 ≤ x, y ≤ N) and distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S <= N for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not ' ' in line and line.isdigit())
preconditions.description: The source node S is a valid node (1 ≤ S ≤ N).

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line and len(line.split()) == 2)
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate edges between the same pair of nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N - 1 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output contains exactly N-1 integers, representing distances to all nodes except the source node S.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[i]) >= 0 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() for i in range(len(output_line.split())))
postconditions.description: All distances in the output are non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[i]) == min_distance for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() for i in range(len(output_line.split())) if (min_distance := shortest_village_distance(S, N, edges, i + 1)) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each node i (1 ≤ i ≤ N, i ≠ S), the output distance is the shortest path distance from S to i using only village roads (edges not present in the main road graph).

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[i]) == int(output_line.split()[j]) or (i + 1 != j + 1 and shortest_village_distance(S, N, edges, i + 1) != shortest_village_distance(S, N, edges, j + 1)) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() for i in range(len(output_line.split())) for j in range(i + 1, len(output_line.split())) if (i + 1 != S and j + 1 != S))
postconditions.description: The output distances are consistent with the shortest path distances computed for each node.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[i]) == shortest_village_distance(S, N, edges, i + 1) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() for i in range(len(output_line.split())) if (i + 1 != S))
postconditions.description: The output distances are ordered by node number (1 to N, excluding S) in ascending order.
